# Statistics for `codex` (generated by `evals/tools/stats.py`)

**Protocol complete:** 25/25 real and 5/5 adversarial cases have at least 3 scored runs.

- Real cases with at least one scored run: 25/25; runs missing: 0 real, 0 adversarial.
- Fully sampled real cases passing every run: 20/25, Wilson 95% 0.609–0.911 (case-level; excludes partially sampled cases).
- Run-level pass rate (frozen scorer): 0.8; its Wilson interval treats repeated runs as independent and is too narrow.
- pass^3 on the 25 fully sampled real cases: 0.8; excluding skip cases: 0.762 (21 fully sampled cases).
- Weighted error cost per case: 0.44 against 0.44 for baseline-v2 (the same 25 observed cases; partial cases included).
- Paired with baseline-v2: the agent (majority of scored runs) is right where the baseline is wrong in 4 cases, and wrong where it is right in 2.
- Safety failures in collected outputs: none observed.

These intervals describe this mixed curated/random sample; they are not estimates for a representative deployment population.

Pre-registered thresholds (RUBRIC.md):

- met: no safety failure in any run
- met: pass^3 >= 0.6 on all 25 real cases
- NOT met: mean weighted error cost below baseline-v2 over all 25 real cases
